chars.name: Yoimiya
chars.desc: Her Elemental Skill turns her Normal Attacks into Pyro arrows. She stays on the field and keeps firing while her team protects and buffs her.

teams.name: Vaporize Fireworks

members.name: Yoimiya
members.does: Fires Pyro arrows with her Normal Attacks while her Skill is active.

members.name: Xingqiu
members.does: His Rain Swords strike alongside her attacks with Hydro, so her Pyro hits can Vaporize.

members.name: Bennett
members.does: His Burst field heals and gives an ATK bonus to whoever stands in it.

members.name: Layla
members.does: Her shield keeps Yoimiya safe so she can keep attacking.

teams.note: Layla’s shield also fires Cryo Shooting Stars, which can Freeze or Melt with the team’s Hydro and Pyro instead of Vaporize. Many players still pick her for the comfort of a strong shield.
teams.lesson: Set up the supporters first, then let Yoimiya attack inside Bennett’s field while Xingqiu’s Rain Swords keep adding Hydro for Vaporize.

rotation.name: Nights of Formal Focus
rotation.what: Creates the Curtain of Slumber shield.
rotation.why: A shield keeps Yoimiya from being knocked around while she attacks.

rotation.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
rotation.what: Slashes the target with Hydro and gives Energy back to the team.
rotation.why: Puts Hydro on the target and helps charge his Burst.

rotation.name: Guhua Sword: Raincutter
rotation.what: Summons Rain Swords that follow the active character.
rotation.why: From now on, Rain Swords strike alongside Normal Attacks, adding Hydro even after he leaves the field.

rotation.name: Fantastic Voyage
rotation.what: Creates a field that heals and gives an ATK bonus.
rotation.why: Yoimiya gets the ATK bonus while she stands inside the field.

rotation.name: Niwabi Fire-Dance
rotation.what: Her Normal Attacks become Pyro Kindling Arrows for a short time.
rotation.why: Without it her arrows are Physical, so they can’t Vaporize.

rotation.name: Kindling Arrows
rotation.what: A string of Pyro arrows while Rain Swords add Hydro.
rotation.why: Pyro hitting a Hydro-soaked target triggers Vaporize, a big damage boost.

mates.name: Xingqiu

pros: The strongest weapon for her playstyle

chars.name: Xiao
chars.desc: His Burst lets him leap high and crash down with Anemo plunges. His supporters set everything up first so his Burst window gets every buff.

teams.name: Wind Strike

members.name: Xiao
members.does: Repeated Anemo plunges during his Burst.

members.name: Faruzan
members.does: Her Burst lowers enemies’ Anemo RES and gives the team an Anemo DMG Bonus.

members.name: Sucrose
members.does: Her Skill makes Anemo Energy particles for Xiao and triggers Swirl.

members.name: Bennett
members.does: His Burst field heals and gives an ATK bonus.

teams.note: Xiao’s Burst slowly drains his HP, so Bennett’s healing helps him stay in the fight.
teams.lesson: Do all of the support setup first. Xiao’s Burst window is short, and every buff should already be active when he starts plunging.

rotation.name: The Wind’s Secret Ways
rotation.what: Lowers the target’s Anemo RES and gives the team an Anemo DMG Bonus.
rotation.why: Makes every Anemo plunge that follows hit harder.

rotation.name: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308
rotation.what: A small Anemo blast that pulls enemies in.
rotation.why: Anemo Energy particles go a long way toward charging Xiao’s Burst.

rotation.name: Fantastic Voyage
rotation.what: Creates a field that heals and gives an ATK bonus; its hit puts Pyro on the target.
rotation.why: Xiao starts his Burst inside the field with the ATK bonus.

rotation.name: Bane of All Evil
rotation.what: His attacks become Anemo and he can leap much higher.
rotation.why: This is his damage window; everything before it was preparation.

rotation.name: Plunging Attack
rotation.what: Jumps high and crashes down with Anemo.
rotation.why: Repeated high plunges are where most of his damage comes from. Anemo hitting Pyro triggers Swirl.

rotation.name: Plunging Attack (again)
rotation.what: Keeps jumping and plunging until his Burst ends.
rotation.why: Staying in the rhythm of jump, plunge, jump keeps his damage steady.

mates.note: C6: a big upgrade to her support

pros: Strong weapon plus a fully upgraded Faruzan

chars.name: Eula
chars.desc: During her Burst, her hits charge the Lightfall Sword. When it ends, it crashes down with a big Physical hit. Superconduct makes that hit land harder.

teams.name: Superconduct Lightfall

members.name: Eula
members.does: Builds Lightfall Sword stacks during her Burst for one huge Physical hit.

members.name: Fischl
members.does: Oz applies Electro from off the field, so Cryo hits trigger Superconduct.

members.name: Diona
members.does: Her shield protects Eula and her Cryo particles charge Eula’s Burst.

members.name: Lisa
members.does: Her Burst applies Electro, and her passive lowers enemy DEF by 15%.

teams.note: Superconduct lowers the target’s Physical RES by 40% for 12 seconds. That’s why this team pairs Cryo with Electro for a Physical character.
teams.lesson: Shield and Electro first, then Eula’s Burst. Every hit during the Burst adds a Lightfall stack, so land as many hits as you can before the sword comes down.

rotation.name: Icy Paws
rotation.why: Protects Eula, and her Cryo particles help charge Eula’s Burst.

rotation.name: Nightrider
rotation.what: Summons Oz, who keeps striking with Electro.
rotation.why: Oz keeps putting Electro on the target after Fischl leaves the field.

rotation.name: Lightning Rose
rotation.what: A rose that zaps nearby enemies with Electro.
rotation.why: Her passive lowers enemy DEF by 15%, and the Electro sets up Superconduct.

rotation.name: Icetide Vortex
rotation.what: A quick Cryo slash that gives her a Grimheart stack.
rotation.why: Cryo on an Electro target triggers Superconduct: Physical RES down by 40%.

rotation.name: Glacial Illumination
rotation.what: Summons the Lightfall Sword above the target.
rotation.why: Starts the window where her hits charge the sword.

rotation.name: Favonius Bladework - Edel
rotation.what: A string of heavy claymore swings.
rotation.why: Each hit adds a stack to the Lightfall Sword, so more hits mean a bigger finish.

rotation.name: Burst detonation
rotation.what: The sword crashes down with every stack she built.
rotation.why: The big Physical hit lands while Superconduct is lowering Physical RES.

rotations.energy_assumptions: Xingqiu and Bennett have enough Energy Recharge to Burst every rotation.
rotations.enemy_assumptions: Works on single targets and small groups.
rotations.rotation_notes: A limited-roster team: no newer characters needed. Fischl alternates: Skill one rotation, Burst the next.
common_mistakes: Swapping out of Yoimiya during Niwabi Fire-Dance ends it early.
Standing outside Bennett’s Burst field loses the ATK buff.
Waiting for Yoimiya’s Burst every rotation: it’s optional.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Xingqiu slashes with water and dashes to cancel the end of the move.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen, dash-cancelled. Applies Hydro and makes particles for his Burst.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: His Burst summons Rain Swords that follow whoever is on the field; one attack starts them.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Guhua Sword: Raincutter; the N1 triggers the first wave. Rain Swords then strike alongside the active character’s Normal Attacks with Hydro.

ordered_actions.display_text: Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst, one attack
ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Bennett makes Energy with his Skill, then drops his healing and ATK-boost field.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Bennett boop. Bennett circle. Stand in circle.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Passion Overload for particles, then Fantastic Voyage: heals below 70% HP and adds an ATK bonus based on Bennett’s base ATK to the character inside.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: If her Energy is full and she isn’t wearing 4-piece Shimenawa’s Reminiscence, she can use her Burst here.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Burst if full. Skip if Shimenawa.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Ryuukin Saxifrage marks a target with Aurous Blaze and buffs teammates’ ATK (A4). Use it only if it’s ready and she isn’t wearing 4-piece Shimenawa’s Reminiscence.

required_conditions.text: Skip this if Yoimiya wears 4-piece Shimenawa’s Reminiscence
Only if her Burst is ready

ordered_actions.display_text: Two attacks, then Skill or Burst
ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Fischl summons Oz, her bird, who keeps zapping with Electro after she leaves.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Nightrider (Skill) one rotation, Midnight Phantasmagoria (Burst) the next; the N2 comes first. Oz attacks from off-field.

branch_conditions.text: Alternate each rotation: Skill (E) one time, Burst (Q) the next.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Her arrows turn into fire for 10 seconds. From now on, stay on her.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Niwabi Fire-Dance: 10s Pyro infusion. Leaving the field ends it.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Keep firing Normal Attacks until her Skill ends. Pyro hitting Hydro from the Rain Swords triggers Vaporize.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Shoot shoot shoot. Fire + water = Vaporize.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Normal Attack strings during Niwabi; Rain Swords and Oz follow. Pyro on a Hydro-affected target triggers Vaporize (and Overloaded with Electro).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Bennett taps his Skill again to make Energy for next time.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Passion Overload after Yoimiya’s field time, for particles toward the next rotation’s Burst.

rotations.energy_assumptions: Enough Energy Recharge for every Burst each rotation (see the build guide for Energy Recharge).
rotations.rotation_notes: One of Xiao’s strongest teams. The order changes with Faruzan’s constellation. Xiao C6 changes the combo, so it isn’t covered here.
common_mistakes: Using Xiao’s Skill during his Burst for Energy: it makes none then.
Switching out of Xiao before his Burst ends.
Skipping a healer: Furina and Xiao both drain HP; Xianyun covers it here.

team.does: Team DMG Bonus from HP changes.

rotations.lesson: Every buff goes up before Xiao’s Burst and his two Skill charges are spent before it (for Energy). Then he never leaves the field until the mask comes off.

rotations.rotation_notation: Furina ED Q > Xianyun EPQ > Faruzan E Q C > Xiao 2[E]Q [combo]

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Furina calls her salon helpers, then starts her party: the team deals more damage as HP goes up and down.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Furina friends out. Party time. Team hit harder.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Salon Solitaire (dash-cancelled), then Let the People Rejoice: Fanfare stacks from HP changes give a team DMG Bonus for most of Xiao’s field time.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Xianyun leaps, plunges, then uses her Burst. Her buff follows Xiao and boosts his plunges.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Bird lady jump. Bird lady buff. Xiao plunge stronger.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: White Clouds at Dawn into its plunge, then Stars Gather at Dusk: a Plunge DMG Base Bonus and CRIT buffs that follow the active character, plus healing.

ordered_actions.display_text: Skill, Burst, then a charged shot
ordered_actions.simple_explanation: At low constellations Faruzan goes after Furina and Xianyun: Skill, Burst, then her special charged shot.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, The Wind’s Secret Ways (Anemo DMG Bonus and Anemo RES shred), then the Hurricane Arrow charged shot. The order for C0–C1 Faruzan.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Xiao uses both Skill charges first, while they still make Energy.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Two Lemniscatic Wind Cycling casts before the Burst; particles stop during Bane of All Evil, so this is the last chance to funnel.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Mask on. From here, stay on Xiao for the whole 15 seconds.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Bane of All Evil: 15s, Anemo infusion and plunge DMG bonus; ends if he leaves the field.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Jump and plunge again and again. Anemo hitting Hydro from Furina triggers Swirl.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Jump. Fall. Jump. Fall. Many times.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: The recommended plunge spam for this team: about 12 high plunges and 2 low plunges (JhP / JlP). Plunges stagger enemies and never hurt Xiao.

rotations.playstyle: On-field Physical Burst damage with Electro and Cryo support
rotations.rotation_notation: Raiden E > Zhongli Hold E > Rosaria E > Eula E > Rosaria Q > Eula Burst rotation (Q N4 hE N4) > Rosaria E > Eula N2 > Raiden Q 3N3C

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Raiden places her Eye, which boosts Burst damage and adds Electro to teammates’ hits.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Transcendence: Baleful Omen: Burst DMG Bonus to the party and coordinated Electro attacks, which set up Superconduct.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Zhongli holds his Skill for a strong shield.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Dominus Lapidis (Hold): Jade Shield and RES shred nearby.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Rosaria’s Skill makes Cryo Energy for Eula.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Ravaging Confession: Cryo particles for Eula.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: A quick tap gives Eula her first Grimheart stack. Cryo on the Electro target triggers Superconduct.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Tap. One stack. Ice + zap = Superconduct.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Icetide Vortex (Press): +1 Grimheart. Cryo on an Electro-affected target triggers Superconduct (−40% Physical RES for 12s).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Rosaria’s Burst keeps hitting with Cryo while Eula is on the field.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Rites of Termination: off-field Cryo and CRIT Rate share (A4).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: The Lightfall Sword appears. Her Skill comes back with a second Grimheart stack.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Glacial Illumination; Wellspring of War-Lust resets Icetide Vortex and adds 1 Grimheart (now 2).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Four swings, each one charging the sword.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Swing swing swing swing. Sword bigger.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Each damaging hit adds 1 stack (max once per 0.1s).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Hold her Skill to spend both Grimheart stacks: a mini Lightfall Sword and lower enemy Physical resistance.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Hold. Spend stacks. Mini sword boom.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Icetide Vortex (Hold) with 2 Grimheart: RES shred, Icewhirl Brands (which also add stacks) and Roiling Rime’s Shattered Lightfall Sword.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Four more swings, then the sword crashes down by itself.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: The default combo (tE Q N4 hE N4) reaches about 13 stacks without Attack SPD buffs. The sword detonates when its 7s ends.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Rosaria’s Skill again for more Cryo Energy.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Ravaging Confession for particles.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: A couple of swings on Eula to collect the Energy.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Eula N2 to absorb particles.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Raiden finishes with her own Burst combo.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Raiden big sword. Slash slash slash.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, then 3 × (N3 + Charged Attack); restores Energy to the team.

yoimiya.keyWhy: Her largest damage gain besides C6, and nearly always active.

1: none
Power from her Burst mark; no rotation change.
2: +25% Pyro DMG after Pyro crits; same buttons, same order.
4: Skill cooldown −1.2s on her own Aurous Blaze explosions; it rarely limits rotations.
6: none
Extra Blazing Arrows; same order. Slightly smaller gain in Vaporize teams.

xiao.keyWhy: His first constellation that touches the rotation (an extra Skill charge every other rotation). It’s a small gain; C6 is the one that changes how he plays.

1: energy
Third Skill charge every other rotation (only one charge recharges at a time).
6: combo
Plunges hitting 2+ enemies refund Skill charges: play shifts to Skill spam. No verified C6 combo in the Coach yet.

eula.keyWhy: +30% Physical DMG whenever Grimheart is consumed, which fits her normal combo.

1: none
+30% Physical DMG when Grimheart is consumed; same order.
6: none
Sword starts with 5 stacks; it allows earlier swaps, but no separate C6 rotation is given, so the order stays.
